title: Determination of squalene in edible oils by transmethylation and GC analysis
author: Budge, Barry

steps.title: Prepare calibration standards
steps.instruction: Create squalene standard solutions in t‑butyl methyl ether (t‑BME) covering ~0.05–20 mg mL⁻¹; add tricosanoic acid methyl ester (23:0) at 1.0 mg mL⁻¹ as internal standard; aliquot <100 mg total mass in volumes of 2.5–10 mL; process each aliquot through the FAME synthesis procedure and finally make up to ~5 mg mL⁻¹ squalene in hexane; prepare each concentration in triplicate.

steps.title: Weigh and spike oil samples
steps.instruction: Weigh 0.3–2.0 g of the edible oil into a 25‑mL volumetric flask, add a calculated mass of 23:0 FAME so its peak area matches the expected squalene area, fill to mark with t‑BME and mix thoroughly; transfer a volume containing <100 mg lipid (1–6 mL) to a test tube for the FAME preparation, and after processing make up to an expected squalene concentration of ~5 mg mL⁻¹ in hexane.

steps.title: Base‑catalyzed transmethylation and squalene isolation
steps.instruction: Perform the following sequence for each sample (including standards and spiked oils):

substeps.instruction: Dissolve the sample in t‑BME and place <100 mg lipid in a test tube.
Reduce the volume to 1 mL using a nitrogen evaporator.
Add 0.5 mL of 0.2 M sodium methoxide in methanol.
Shake vigorously for 1 min, then let stand for 2 min at room temperature.
Add 0.1 mL of 0.5 M H₂SO₄(aq) to stop the reaction and mix vigorously for 15 s.
Add ~1.5 mL distilled water and mix for another 15 s.
Collect the upper (organic) phase containing FAME and squalene, dry it over anhydrous Na₂SO₄.
Transfer the dried extract to a clean test tube, evaporate the solvent, and re‑dissolve to a final concentration of 5 mg mL⁻¹ squalene in hexane.
Total preparation time is typically <30 min.

steps.title: GC‑FID analysis of squalene
steps.instruction: Inject the prepared hexane solutions onto a gas chromatograph equipped with a flame‑ionization detector and a column of (50% cyanopropyl)-methylpolysiloxane; use the 23:0 FAME peak as internal standard to quantify squalene by the external‑standard method.
